name: autocomplete-paths
author: lumine-code
description: Complete file paths from the project file index.

normalizeSlashes.title: Normalize Slashes
normalizeSlashes.description: Use forward slashes in inserted paths on every platform.

suggestionPriority.title: Suggestion Priority
suggestionPriority.description: Priority reported to the autocomplete service. Above the 2 a language server reports, so that an explicitly typed path outranks a general identifier list -- this provider only answers when a path prefix actually matched, so it never displaces anything otherwise.

imagePreview.title: Image Previews
imagePreview.description: Display image thumbnails in path suggestions.

ignoredNames.title: Additional Ignored Names
ignoredNames.description: Paths matching these glob patterns are left out of path suggestions. The editor's Ignored Names and VCS-ignore settings already apply to the shared project index; these narrow it further for suggestions alone.

scopes.title: Custom Scopes
scopes.description: Additional scope, prefix, extension, and replacement definitions.

enableHtmlSupport.title: HTML Attribute Support
enableHtmlSupport.description: Suggest paths inside common HTML path attributes.
